title: docs(releases): 18.3.0 names the fail-closed type-mismatch refusal it shipped without a CHANGELOG entry, and the cut runbook regenerates the version PR first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB5g6ijEgWBsfDpUAX9vFHFC)_

Fixes #29957

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 18.3 发布页在「需手动处理 › Metadata the build, lint and save doors now refuse」下补一条：#29923 的收窄（失败即拒的谓词里文本/布尔字段和数字比大小，18.2.0 发布时只给 warning、之后拒掉每次写入 → 18.3.0 在发布时直接拒），写明它实际发出的 `type-mismatch` + `params.outcome: 'fail-closed'`，以及 main 上 #29953 已把它改名为 `type-mismatch-fail-closed`。`docs/releases-maintenance.md` 加三步编号的发版顺序：合并 Version Packages PR 前列出 main 在其分叉点之后新增的 changeset 并刷新；发布后确认版本提交留下的 pending changeset 为零，不为零就写进发布页。
- **为什么改:** #26517 13:39Z 从 `40a35ded` 生成后，14:44Z 合并时没有再刷新，落后 main 5 次合入，4 个 changeset（其中 1 个是破坏性的 #29923）的代码进了 18.3.0，但 CHANGELOG 没有它们。发布页的「Release facts」里已经点名了这 4 个，但破坏性那条不在需手动处理列表里，也没写出实际的拒绝码。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改两份文档，无代码、无 changeset、无 workflow 改动。没有加守卫：`scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` 里 #23818 已测量过 main 约每 20 分钟一次带 changeset 的合入，拒绝过期 PR 的检查几乎会拦住每次发版，所以选运行手册步骤。回滚 = revert。
- **先看:** `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx` 新增的那条（约第 283 行起），以及 `docs/releases-maintenance.md` 的「The cut, in order」三步。
- **两分钟验证:** 在完整 clone 上跑 `node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs unconsumed --version-commit 83d7e4ae --version 18.3.0`，预期列出 4 个 changeset；第 1 步的命令换成 `git merge-base 72d7db03 b1c4119e`（#26517 的 head）后同样列出这 4 个文件。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位审阅落地（文档 PR，`skip-changeset`）。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`.** Under 需手动处理 › *Metadata the build, lint and save doors now refuse*, the count line now says "8 entries, and one more that 18.3.0 ships with no entry in its CHANGELOGs", followed by a bullet for #29923: the sites (validation rule `condition` / `when`, `requiredWhen`, `readonlyWhen`, option `visibleWhen`, hook `condition`), the before and after (18.2.0 published with an `expression-invalid` warning and then refused every write it could not evaluate; 18.3.0 refuses at `os validate`, `os build`, the object save door and publish at `severity: error`), the refusal it carries (`type-mismatch` with `params.outcome: 'fail-closed'`, the same on MCP `validate_expression` for `site: 'validation'`), the remedy, the upgrade-guide entry `validation-type-mismatch-refused`, and that `main` serves it as `type-mismatch-fail-closed` since #29953. The *Release facts* note that already named the four leaked changesets now points to that bullet. The counts the page takes from the CHANGELOGs (8, 264, 1,379) are unchanged, because the entry is not in them.
- **`docs/releases-maintenance.md`.** *Cutting a GA release* gains "The cut, in order": (1) list the changesets `main` gained since the Version Packages PR's branch point, with the command, and refresh until the list is empty; (2) the existing wait for a nearer `CI` run; (3) confirm the version commit left zero changesets pending (the Release run's `Changesets:` summary, or `unconsumed` on a full clone), and name any leak in the curated page, a breaking one under 需手动处理. It says why this is a step and not a check, with the 18.3.0 measurement. The stale "#4935" in the *First, check* paragraph becomes "the Version Packages PR".

## Why

### The CHANGELOG question

`docs/releases-maintenance.md` says the per-package `CHANGELOG.md` files are generated and never hand-edited, and that the curated page is where the platform narrative lives. The CHANGELOG half of the erratum is already automatic: the root `version` script runs `release-pending-publish.mjs annotate-shipped` before `changeset version`, so the next cut renders each of these four entries with a lead line `**Shipped in 18.3.0**, whose CHANGELOG missed this entry; listed here one release late.` (as 18.3.0 did for four of 18.2.0's). So this PR edits no CHANGELOG and no pending changeset.

### Every changeset 18.3.0 skipped

Measured with `git log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 origin/main -- <f>` and `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> 83d7e4ae` over all 43 pending `.changeset/*.md` on `main` at `c618e890`. Four are ancestors of the cut. `node scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs unconsumed --version-commit 83d7e4ae --version 18.3.0` (full clone) names the same four:

| Changeset | Added by | Operator-visible | On the 18.3 page |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `29904-type-mismatch-fail-closed.md` | `4c2cd29a` (#29923) | yes, breaking: publish refuses what 18.2.0 accepted | Release facts note, sweep table, upgrade checklist step 2; **now also under 需手动处理 with the served refusal (this PR)** |
| `29903-base-export-without-pair-extension.md` | `5f474102` (#29930) | yes: a base's own export no longer carries its `.custom` pair's extension | Release facts note and sweep table (since #29938) |
| `password-reset-revocation-trail.md` | `7b2bb668` (#29921) | yes: a self-service reset keeps and stamps `sys_session` rows (`revoke_reason: password_reset`) instead of deleting them | Release facts note (since #29938) |
| `org-admin-removal-caller-read.md` | `72d7db03` (#29932) | yes: an org admin's refused removal answers the same 403 for an unreadable row as for a missing one | Release facts note (since #29938) |

The three non-breaking ones need no further line: each is a fix that declares no breaking change and no protocol kind, which the page's 其他修复 section counts but does not list, and the *Release facts* note already names each with its commit. None of them is in the 其他修复 counts, which come from the CHANGELOGs.

### Why #26517 merged stale

`83d7e4ae` is the squash of #26517 onto `72d7db03`. The PR's head `b1c4119e` (committed 13:39Z) has parent `40a35ded` (#29922, 13:07Z). `git log --first-parent 40a35ded..72d7db03` is five landings: `7b2bb668` (#29921), `4c2cd29a` (#29923), `242665f1` (#29931, a checklist edit), `5f474102` (#29930), `72d7db03` (#29932). `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A 40a35ded 72d7db03 -- .changeset/` lists exactly the four changesets above. The PR was merged at 14:44Z without another refresh. The runbook already said to check the PR is current, but gave no command; the Release run's `unconsumed` report did warn "Name them in the 18.3.0 release notes", and #29938 named them, but only in the facts note.

### Guard or runbook step

Runbook step. `scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs` (under `annotate-shipped`, #23818) records why refusing a stale Version Packages PR is not the remedy: `main` took a changeset-bearing landing about every twenty minutes (77 of 111 landings in 24 h), so such a check would refuse nearly every cut. The repo answers the leak with `unconsumed` (report) and `annotate-shipped` (next CHANGELOG). The order allows a guard only if it would not block the release flow on false positives; this one would block on true positives almost every time, so this PR adds no check and no `.github/workflows/**` edit.

## Verification

Gates from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` for this change set, run at `d7feeed3` after a `turbo run build` of `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/spec`: **51 derived, 51 run, all exit 0**; `dispatch-gates --ran`: "51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0. One family, `check:skill-examples`, exited 3 on the first pass (`packages/client-react/dist` not built, nothing measured); after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client-react...` it exited 0 (283 examples). Among them: `check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:release-section-coverage` (plain, `--strict`, `--self-test`), `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:issue-citations`, `check-adr-links`.

The step-1 command, replayed on 18.3.0 (`origin/main` → `72d7db03`, `origin/changeset-release/main` → `b1c4119e`): merge base `40a35ded`, four files listed. Anti-no-op: the same diff from `72d7db03` to itself lists zero.

`content/docs/releases/` is release-owned (AGENTS.md); this is the dedicated docs-only PR AGENTS.md prescribes for a factual gap on a releases page, with no code riding along. Changeset: none (`skip-changeset`), docs only.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (none added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran. No code changed, so `pnpm lint` has nothing new to judge.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [ ] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. Edits `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx` as a docs-only erratum PR, per AGENTS.md's "factual error on a releases page → dedicated docs-only PR".
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the dispatch convention)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
